reviews.text: Great experience at this hair salon! The staff was welcoming, polite, and professional. My stylist listened carefully and gave me a stylish, fresh haircut that suits me perfectly. The salon was clean, comfortable, and relaxing. I’m very happy with the result and would highly recommend it!

I love Naz!! I’ve seen hair stylists all over the country and she’s the best!! Consistently has the best advice and styling, and outstanding coloring. I’ve been seeing her exclusively for nearly 25 years!
Oxygen is absolutely phenomenal! From the atmosphere to the services, I have never had a bad experience. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a new salon.
